description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be discontinued.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh: 任务ID，成功调用[SwitchSynchronizationEndpoint](~~201858~~)接口后会返回该值。
description.en: The task ID. This value is returned after you successfully call the [SwitchSynchronizationEndpoint](~~201858~~) operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-endpoint-switch-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id 110000 --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
